title: 14th sitting of the 20th Majlis

items.text: Opening recitation (Hamd and Salawat); the sitting begins.
Roll call of members present at the sitting.
Announcement of the day's agenda (Agenda No. އޖ/14/2024).

Question from Kendhoo MP Mauroof Zakir to the Minister of Construction and Infrastructure, Dr Abdulla Muththalib: the B. Kendhoo water and sewerage project, started under the previous government through MWSC and nearly complete, has now stalled; by what date will it be finished and the service delivered?

Question from Kendhoo MP Mauroof Zakir to the Minister of Construction and Infrastructure, Dr Abdulla Muththalib: the major problems with the B. Dhonfanu harbour development have been raised with the authorities without a satisfactory answer or solution; when will they be resolved?

From the Speaker's desk: the President's nominee for a member of the Human Rights Commission of the Maldives, under Article 5 of the Human Rights Commission Act (Law No. 6/2006), is sent to the relevant standing committee for review.
Preliminary debate on the bill to amend the Criminal Procedure Act (Law No. 12/2016), submitted on behalf of the government by Manadhoo MP Husnee Mubarik.
Voting on items from the day's business that have reached the voting stage.

summary: The sitting questioned the Construction Minister about Baa atoll projects, sent a Human Rights Commission nominee to committee, and opened debate on the Criminal Procedure Act amendment.
